Dominion.OperationDef.label: establish a network
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Recruit informants and contacts among the target faction. A network raises your intel on them every day, makes later operations more likely to succeed, and slowly fades unless renewed. Suspicious factions may uncover part of it.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: gather intelligence
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Agents observe and ask questions. On success your intel on the faction rises sharply, and any reports about them that had not reached you yet arrive at once. In person, your agents must reach their archives and get out: more intel.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: spread propaganda
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Win hearts among their people: their opinion of you improves and the peace-minded bloc grows.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: bribe an official
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Buy a friend in their administration with 400 silver. Their opinion of you improves and you learn more about them.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: assassinate the leader
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Only in person. Your agents enter one of their settlements, where their leader is waiting (or, if the leader is away, a senior official), and kill them. A new leader takes over with little legitimacy. If you are caught it may mean war.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: sabotage
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Only in person. Your agents destroy a marked building in one of their settlements (power and stores first). Goods burn in their stockpiles, and for about six days their economy is 12% weaker and their military 15% weaker. It counts in a war.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: incite riots
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Fund agitators and malcontents. Stability falls sharply, riots break out, and a shaky regime may not survive them.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: stage a coup
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Topple an unstable government and put your own people in charge. The new regime becomes your puppet: it pays a little tribute, never attacks you, joins your wars, and counts as subjugated for the Federation. Needs a network of 30 and a target with stability 45 or less.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: false flag
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Stage an incident and leave evidence pointing at a third faction. The target blames them and may even go to war with them. If the truth comes out, both turn on you.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: steal technology
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Copy their research: progress on your current project, more from more advanced factions. In person, your agents must reach a marked workshop and get out, for a bigger haul.

Dominion.OperationDef.label: rescue a captive
Dominion.OperationDef.description: Only in person. Your agents enter one of their settlements, where a colonist they hold is kept prisoner, reach them and bring them home.
